name: Mid-Market Wholesale & Cross-Border Distribution
industries: Wholesale, B2B Distribution, Logistics, FMCG Trading
pains: Inventory reconciliation latency, customs/VAT compliance, stock mismatch across channels, manual order handling
technology: Sage, Minimax, BaseLinker, spreadsheets, legacy on-premise ERP
triggers: Cross-border warehouse expansion, multi-channel Shopify/B2B demand, tax compliance modernization

name: Omnichannel Retail & E-Commerce (SAP / Legacy Migration)
industries: Retail, Fashion, Cosmetics, Jewellery, Specialty Stores
businessModels: Multi-store physical retail, e-commerce, blended B2B/B2C
pains: High licensing/maintenance cost of tier-1 ERPs (SAP), disjointed POS and online stock sync, custom ledger overhead
technology: SAP, legacy POS, WooCommerce, Shopify, Excel/Zoho
triggers: SAP contract renewal or cost-reduction mandate, new physical store openings, omnichannel expansion

name: Process Manufacturing & FMCG Supply Chain
industries: FMCG, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Textiles, Industrial Manufacturing
businessModels: Batch/recipe manufacturing, packaging production, auction-based trading
pains: Lack of demand forecasting, production scheduling bottlenecks, manual regulatory tax filings, disconnected auction workflows
technology: Fragmented custom desktop apps, paper-based floor logs, isolated accounting software
triggers: Production capacity scaling, government e-invoicing/tax authority mandates, auction scale growth

name: Banking, NBFIs & Specialized Regulatory Workflows
industries: Financial Services, NBFIs, Economic Zones, Multi-country Enterprises
businessModels: Financial lending, special economic development, cross-border corporate management
pains: Manual loan management, audit tracking inefficiency, central bank compliance reporting, multi-country payroll friction
technology: Disconnected banking tools, core systems lacking workflow automation, spreadsheet tracking
triggers: Regulatory reporting mandates (e.g. Bangladesh Bank), international branch expansion, audit compliance deadlines
